svg.text: The Hulse–Taylor pulsar's orbit shrinking from gravitational waves, simulated over 1000 orbits
periastron's shift from a steady period (ms)
Simulated dP/dt = -2.40201e-12, 2.6e-4 from the prediction (limit 8.5e-4: the catalog's masses' rounding, and
the prediction's own uncertainty), -1.0σ from the measured -2.398e-12 ± 4.000e-15.
